actions.description: Review exact source, artifacts and production qualification
Establish network, public roles, custody and bounded authority
Apply the safest owner-authorized partial SN25 trim; prove protected identities survive and report every residual old generation without claiming a full reset
Deploy exact custody graph, validator-evidence journal and coordinator binding; then prove code, ownership and constructor state
Register approved pool, escrow, miner and UR-validator generations
Run the separate netuid-0 role only for an approved existing seat and strategy
Start both independent standard UR validators with the two-operator safety quorum before requiring their first production rows
Start independent monitoring and verify alert/repair ownership
Activate the approved 10/90 evidence-based producer and owner Recycle mode; retain actual rows and native state before economic acceptance
Observe actual production outcomes, settle accrued value and publish complete evidence

execution_blockers: Semantic validators for every supplied review manifest are required; byte identity does not satisfy a capability or custody gate
Exact per-action origin/payload/nonce/address/postcondition adapters and bounded lifetime ledger are not implemented by this planner
This review-only graph cannot authorize the separate executable local-custody bootstrap phase or any chain phase; each chain phase needs its own signed action, ceilings and expiry
Revalidate current identity, runtime, generations and retained receipts at execution; an offline snapshot cannot establish present readiness
limits: Both source builds are sequential with distinct initially empty Go caches. Image repeats use separate initially empty owned containerd/Docker stores; image-only daemons are stopped/joined. A separate private test owner started PostgreSQL/Redis fixtures, removed its containers and joined its own daemons.
Local byte equality does not prove independent compiler/package provenance, arm64 behavior, archive restore or SBOM/scanner/attestation policy.
Actual production policy/configuration, migration/rollout readiness, published/running image identity and release/deployment approval remain absent.

Original component receipts keep their original source and test scopes. The fresh 42-root SN normal/race and 46-root server normal/race scopes are separately retained; no full application, production database or live service qualification is claimed.
The accepted exact v470 artifact exception is a separately scoped planning decision; it does not change this frozen binary source or grant live runtime, release or deployment authority.

This exact SN1320845d/server0aa1e244 composition includes owner retained intent, contract funding/role admission and recycle custody plus server prober/escrow/schema-752 changes. Later source deltas require separate intake; neither component tests nor local repeated builds grant launch authority or independent compiler provenance.
